note: Gold-set benchmark for Skill_by_Satya routing. Decisions: route | ambiguous | no_route. For route cases, `skills` is the expected skill or minimal ordered skill set (order matters when `ordered: true`). `alternatives` are acceptable second choices. Scored: decision accuracy, top-1 (route skill in skills/alternatives), top-3 recall (expected skill appears among returned candidates/alternatives), false-route rate, false-no-route rate, ambiguity precision, multi-skill correctness.

cases.prompt: proofread this paragraph and fix the grammar mistakes
cases.reason: Explicit proofreading + grammar fix -> impeccable.

cases.reason: De-slop + remove ai cliches -> antislop.

cases.prompt: write a readme and draft the marketing blurb for the api
cases.reason: Technical docs + marketing copy: two distinct skills.

cases.prompt: make my code impeccable
cases.reason: 'Impeccable' is a writing-skill name but the object is code. V1 routed here on alias+keyword to a WRITING skill (wrong). V2 must exclude impeccable on object mismatch and surface only the code-adjacent candidate for host-AI confirmation.

cases.prompt: check the security of my css
cases.reason: Neither skill truly fits, but css-protips is the only surfaceable candidate. V2 must NOT invent a confident route; host AI confirms.

cases.prompt: run a hallmark check on my react component
cases.reason: 'Hallmark' is a prose skill; the object is a react component. V1 routed to hallmark on name+keyword (wrong). V2 must exclude hallmark on object mismatch, and the only incidental weak match stays below the floor -> NO_ROUTE.

cases.prompt: write a design review of my backend api
cases.reason: 'Design review' misleads toward design-audit; the object is the backend api. V1 misses it entirely (strict token matching); V2 routes to backend-review.
